answer: Admission auction blocks bulk fake identities. Each epoch only 100 entry slots are auctioned; applicants post sealed bids, and winners pay their bid as a non-refundable fee. Even at the nadir of demand, the floor bid is 40 units, so 100 fakes cost 100 x 40 = 4,000 units before any reward. An honest agent pays once, keeps its ember alive by trading, and earns undiluted rewards, while a plume of identical bids from one controller loses its slots.
